## Structured Data & Meta Tags

* JSON-LD structured data — auto-generated schema.org markup (Organization, BreadcrumbList, Article, etc.)
* Open Graph tags — `og:*` and `twitter:card` meta tag generation
* Page property fields — additional TCA fields on pages for SEO overrides

## Backend & Redirects

* Backend statistics — SEO score overview per page in a backend module
* Sitemap helpers — extended sitemap configuration via `cms-seo`
* Redirect management — manage URL redirects via `cms-redirects`

## Analytics

* Matomo widgets — dashboard widgets showing Matomo analytics data via `typo3-matomo-widgets`
